description.en: From the popular MSV "Mobile Suit Gundam SEED ASTRAY", Gundam Astray Gold Frame Amatsu

description.ja: 最新のプロポーションと可動、ギミック構造を備えた1/144 ＨＧで登場！
description.en: Introducing 1/144 HG with the latest proportions, movement, and gimmick structure!

description.ja: ９月店頭発売予定「ＨＧ ガンダムアストレイゴールドフレームアマツミナ」（別売）と合わせて揃えよう!
description.en: Get it together with 9 Store Release Scheduled "HG Gundam Astray Gold Frame Amatsu Mina" (sold separately)!

description.ja: ●“アマツミナ”とは形状が違う特徴的な脚部を新規造形で忠実再現！！
description.en: -The characteristic legs, which are different in shape from “Amatsumina”, are faithfully reproduced with new modeling! !

description.ja: ●　本体成形色は、グロスインジェクションで光沢のある仕上がり。ゴールド部分は、金色の成形色で再現。
description.en: ● The main body molding color is gloss injection with a glossy finish. The gold part is reproduced with gold molding color.

description.ja: ●‘マガノイクタチ’には展開ギミックを搭載し、大迫力のダイナミックなポージングを安定して再現可能。
description.en: -‘Maganoi Kutachi’ is equipped with a deployment gimmick, allowing you to stably reproduce impressive and dynamic poses.

description.ja: ●‘トリケロス改’を右腕に装備可能。シールド部分には細かなディテールを施し、メカ感のあるシャープな印象の仕上がり。
description.en: -Can be equipped with 'Trikeros Kai' on the right arm. The seal part has fine details, giving it a sharp mechanical feel.

description.ja: 先端部にはクリア成形のビーム刃が取り付け可能。
description.en: A clear molded beam blade can be attached to the tip.

description.ja: ●‘マガノシラホコ’は、付属のリード線で射出シーンを再現可能。
description.en: ●‘Magano Shirahoko’ can reproduce the injection scene with the included lead wire.

description.ja: 付属武装 ： マガノイクタチ／マガノシラホコ／トリケロス改 他
description.en: Attached weapons: Maganoikutachi/Magano Shirahoko/Trikeros Kai and others
